offering_description.value: Operates and franchises drive-thru beverage shops selling specialty coffee, energy drinks, teas, lemonades and smoothies, plus some food items, to consumers. Drinks are made to order at company-operated and franchised shops, and the company also sells some products online.

primary_products.value: espresso-based coffee drinks; cold brew and iced coffee; energy drinks; teas and lemonades; smoothies and baked goods

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers buying drinks at drive-thru shops; B2B: franchisees who license the brand and buy supplies

end_markets.value: quick-service restaurants; specialty coffee and beverages

revenue_model.value: product sales: beverages and food sold at company-operated shops, coffee, syrups and supplies sold to franchisees, packaged goods online; licensing or royalties: royalties and fees from franchised shops

value_chain_position.value: retailer: company-owned drive-thru shops serving consumers with beverages made from purchased ingredients; brand owner: franchises the brand and supplies franchisees with products

geography_served.value: US national: Shops in western, southwestern, midwestern and southern US states, including Oregon, Arizona, Texas and Florida

specialization.value: niche specialist: drive-thru specialty beverage shops, company-owned and franchised

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated drive-thru shops; other: franchised drive-thru shops; online: mobile app ordering and online store for merchandise and packaged coffee

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety, labeling and labor rules, franchise regulation by FTC and state authorities
